problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents taking their foot off the gas in Q4
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Encourage agents to continue working hard during 'separation season' to set the foundation for future success.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Lack of new leads during slower months
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Focus on consistent actions like making calls, sending texts, and maintaining CRM to plant seeds for future transactions.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Agents not following up with past clients
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Stay in touch with past clients regularly to ensure they remember you when they need a REALTOR again.

episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the concept of 'separation season,' a time when agents can differentiate themselves by maintaining consistent effort during slower months. He emphasizes the importance of analyzing past transactions to identify successful strategies and encourages agents to push beyond their comfort zones to achieve long-term success. The episode provides actionable insights for both individual agents and team leaders looking to motivate their teams.
